claim_legs.durability: Prospective source pins, exact Git-bound dependencies, first-run observations and complete recovery manifests are tracked. Saved-only audit/recovery authenticate without a new fixture or original raw-log access; the explicit book watcher binds the current published count. The preflight also proves exact adaptation of the qualified row-oracle body.
claim_legs.falsify: Independent source-scope and healthy-prefix/remaining-owner oracles agree before and after execution. Row/domain/header controls reject lost closes, altered effects, invented retirement, missing runtime reference, changed workspace and retired setup. Recovery-copy and book-count controls reject omitted or redirected evidence and outcome redistribution.
claim_legs.rederive: Committed selectors define the complete active-runtime domain. Immutable observations preserve actual calls, close returns, EIO reports, inactive attempts and file effects. The original active-state oracle compares runtime reference/workspace snapshots with their initial identities. The book watcher independently recounts cases and original TAP.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Last-observation, primary/grouped errors, genuine omissions, final release applicability and native/lifetime remain separate. No prior qualifier/fixture, original main or native process is replayed. Historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain gated.
scope: Active-runtime healthy control and every selected single EIO close report. Actual successful close and observed native closure precede substitution. The original runtime reference and private workspace remain unchanged through release; fixture cleanup subsequently removes the owned roots.
